title: ר' יעקב בר ברתיה דר"א בר יעקב

paragraphs: R. Yaakov, the son of the daughter of R. Aḥa bar Yaakov [ר״א in the heading], was raised by his grandfather R. Aḥa. When he grew up, [his grandfather] said to him, 'Give me water to drink.' He said to him, 'Am I your son? I am your daughter's son,' Sotah (49a). Yuḥasin writes: 'R. Yaakov, the son of the son of Rav Yaakov Idi, grew up with his grandfather,' at the end of Sotah. A different reading came his way, or it is a scribal error.
